text_block_list.text:
After our outing, as Special Week and I
walked along the road back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew...!
Today was so much fun too...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When I first came here,
there were so many things I was anxious about, but—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Trainer being by my side,
I feel like that anxiety has started to fade away.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're always so dependable, Trainer,
and being with you puts me at ease...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It really makes me realize just what an incredible person she is.
choice_data_list: You can think of me as a stand-in for your mom.
I guess you could call it wisdom and experience.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What?!
I-I'd feel so bad taking you up on that...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And well, how should I put it, hmm...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Mom and Trainer are two different things.
It's not about replacing one with the other or anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So please, stay by my side as my Trainer
from here on out too. I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh... Really? That's a bit surprising.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still... I kind of feel a sense of closeness with you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I forget my homework and get scolded by teachers too, or forget my umbrella and get soaked to the bone, so—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I know! If you ever mess up,
Trainer, I'll help you out!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Since you're always doing so much for me,
I'm gonna do my absolute beeest!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wisdom and experience...!! That sounds, like, super grown-up...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I-I want to gain wisdom and experience too!!
How do I get them!?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Like reading lots of books...?
Or talking to lots of different people...!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"V-Various"... That doesn't tell me anything!!
Please tell me more, Trainer!!
